Year(s) of the sampling campaign
City of sampling
Country

Sample identifier as in the source file
1 if the source authors flagged the sample as an outlier (Englund Kampala 'out' = YES)
Total solids, g/L
Volatile solids, g/L
Chemical oxygen demand, g/L
Ammonium nitrogen, mg/L
Capillary suction time, s
'measured g/L' or 'from %wt' (= %wt x 10 x density; density 1 g/mL if not measured)
pit latrine | septic tank | other (cesspit, holding tank)
1 = fully lined / sealed / watertight; 0 = partially lined, unlined or not sealed
Containment volume, m3
Number of people using the toilet(s) feeding the containment
1 = household (single or multiple); 0 = public, school, commercial, institutional
1 = pour-flush or cistern-flush toilet; 0 = dry or urine-diverting only
1 = bathing, laundry or kitchen water also enters; 0 = toilet only
1 = piped water connection on premises
1 = solid waste (incl. hygiene products) present in containment
1 = anything added to the containment (chemicals, bio-additives, ash, soap ...)
Containment age, years (categories converted to midpoints: <1 = 0.5, 1-5 = 3, 6-10 = 8, >10 = 15)
1 = containment never emptied since construction
Years since last emptying (Englund Kampala: reported emptying interval)
Years the sampled sludge has been accumulating = years_since_emptied, or age_yr if never emptied
pH of sample
Electrical conductivity, mS/cm
